mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_dict_data WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, dict_sort, remark, status, create_time FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY dict_sort ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_data (dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, dict_sort, remark, status) VALUES (#{dictType}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, #{dictSort}, #{remark}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_data SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
